_meta.note: This module's own texts. The host reads this file from locales/en.json beside the bundle's entry and merges it under the module's namespace. Copy it to <tag>.json to translate; a key you leave out falls back to the line here.
autostorager.page.title: Auto-Storager
autostorager.page.body: Edit ui/src/page.svelte to change this page.
autostorager.page.what: This module watches a folder and hands every print file it finds to the storage, where it appears like a manual upload with its preview and slicer details. Nothing is moved or deleted before the copy is complete.
autostorager.page.delay: A file that just appeared is picked up within about one interval, and a large file adds the time it needs to be copied.
autostorager.page.names: If a file of that name already exists in the storage, this module adds -1, -2 and so on until the name is free. Nothing is overwritten.
autostorager.page.docker: On Linux with the server in a container, create the folder on the host first, mount it into the container, and enter the container path here. The README explains the mount.
autostorager.page.no: leave the source where it is
autostorager.page.folderHint: The absolute path on the server. Under Linux in a container this is the path inside the container, so the host folder has to be mounted first.
autostorager.page.intervalHint: Seconds between two looks into the folder. 60 s = 1 min. A very short interval means constant requests, which costs I/O on a network share; five seconds is enough for most folders.
autostorager.page.maxHint: A larger file is moved into failed/ with a reason instead of being imported.
